text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ Now I just add the soy sauce
and let it
simmer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Are my hands usually this red?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now that I think about it, I have
been
washing dishes recently.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As a public figure, I need to stay on top
of even
the smallest details of my
appearance...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's skin has been irritated
lately.
